summary: The @gyomu/agent package serves as a primary orchestrator within the Gyomu ecosystem, integrating AI-driven analysis with project-specific code intelligence. It leverages specialized dependencies for infrastructure, schema management, and TypeScript documentation to enable advanced agentic workflows.
responsibilities: Orchestrate interactions between AI models and local project infrastructure.
Implement agentic decision-making logic for code-related tasks.
Bridge high-level analytical goals with concrete TypeScript codebase operations.
Manage the lifecycle and state of automated project analysis agents.

capabilities.name: Agent Orchestration
capabilities.description: Provides the structural framework to define and execute autonomous agents capable of performing complex code analysis and transformation tasks.

capabilities.name: Code Intelligence Integration
capabilities.description: Exposes capabilities for deep semantic analysis of TypeScript code by utilizing underlying structural and documentation models.

capabilities.name: Analytical Workflow Management
capabilities.description: Coordinates multi-step processes involving schema validation, AI inference, and infrastructure interaction.

designDecisions: Employs a functional effect-based architecture to handle complex asynchronous operations and side effects reliably.
Decouples domain-specific analysis logic from infrastructure concerns by utilizing core Gyomu dependency packages.
Prioritizes declarative definitions for agent behaviors to ensure maintainability and testability.
usageGuidance: Extend the base agent classes or configurations to define custom task-specific behaviors.
Utilize the provided test infrastructure to validate agent behavior against representative code snippets.
Ensure environment configurations and infrastructure dependencies are initialized before invoking primary agent orchestration APIs.
